metadata.scenario: A new customer urgently requests a plumber as their bathroom is flooding. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, this is Robert Jackson. I need help urgently! My bathroom is flooding! I'm sorry to hear that, Robert. Unfortunately, we don't provide plumbing services. I understand, but it's really urgent! Water is everywhere! I get that it’s an emergency. Have you tried calling a plumber? No, I haven’t. I thought you might have someone you could recommend. We don't have plumbing services, but I can suggest you look up local plumbers online or in the Yellow Pages. Could you please provide a referral? My hands are full right now. I wish I could help you with a specific name, but we don't keep contacts for plumbers. Okay, but can you at least help me with my current care? Of course! We can assist with your ongoing care needs. Would you like to schedule a nurse visit? Yes, I think that would help ease my mind a bit. I had a nurse visit just three days ago. I see. We can send a nurse back out for you. Would you prefer medication management or personal care assistance? The medication management, please. Great choice. I can schedule someone for tomorrow, does that work for you? Yes, that works. Can you send Robert? Robert is available. I’ll confirm that he’ll be there around the same time tomorrow. Perfect, thank you! You're welcome! Just a reminder to keep your details updated with us, especially with your neurologist's care instructions. I will. Do you think you can help me with respite care for my family later this week? We can definitely arrange that. I can get you the pricing for respite care after our nurse visits. Sounds good, I appreciate all your help, Margaret. Anytime, Robert! Please take care of that flooding situation, and we'll see you tomorrow. I will, thank you! Thank you for calling CareFirst! Have a good day. Bye.
